en: Black‑and‑white image showing a dense religious street procession moving along a cobblestoned city street between rows of multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. Hooded and cloaked participants carry long staffs or spears and religious statues, followed by clergy and other costumed figures, while large crowds line both sides of the street and look on from windows above. The scene evokes a Catholic Holy Week or Passion procession in a European town.
